plans.note: Only the preamble is exposed in the outline, but a Master Services Agreement of this type almost always carries a limitation of liability article; scan the full body text under sec-preamble for a cap, consequential-damages waiver and carve-outs, and check mutuality and whether the cap is tied to fees paid.

Expect a vendor indemnity (third-party IP infringement, gross negligence/willful misconduct) in the body under sec-preamble; confirm any reciprocal customer indemnity is limited to our content/data and does not sweep in general breach.
Presence rule — ad-tech MSAs rarely restrain the customer's other lines of business; search the sec-preamble body for 'compete', 'competing', 'restricted business' before concluding absence.
Presence rule — check the services/scope and any inventory or supply provisions in the body for 'exclusive', 'sole provider' or 'all of Customer's requirements'; flag only if such wording binds AP.
Direction rule — look in fees/pricing text for 'most favoured/favored nation' or 'no less favourable terms'; welcome if it runs in our favour, flag only if AP must give Kubient best terms.

Check the general/miscellaneous provisions in the body for a non-solicitation covenant; confirm it is mutual, time-limited (12 months or less) and carves out general advertising and unsolicited applicants.

Term and termination language should sit in the body; the defined term 'Initial Term' signals a term clause exists. Verify AP may terminate for convenience on notice without penalty and that Kubient cannot terminate at will mid-term.
'Initial Term' implies renewal wording follows; check for auto-renewal, the non-renewal notice window (prefer 30 days or less) and any uncapped price uplift on renewal.
Expect governing law/venue in the miscellaneous provisions; confirm NY, DE, CA or England and Wales and courts rather than foreign or mandatory arbitration.

Look for an assignment clause in the miscellaneous provisions; confirm AP may assign to affiliates and successors without consent and that a change of control does not give Kubient a termination right.

Direction rule — locate the intellectual property/data provisions in the body; confirm AP retains ownership of its content, data and any paid-for deliverables and that no AP IP or data is assigned or broadly licensed to Kubient.
Check the grant language accompanying the services/platform access; confirm it extends to AP affiliates and contractors and is not revocable at Kubient's discretion.

Parametric rule — search the body for audit/inspection or records provisions; if Kubient may audit AP usage, check frequency, notice, on-site scope and who bears cost. Reporting obligations running to AP are not an audit right.
Direction rule — review fees/termination text for liquidated damages, early termination fees or penalty language payable by AP; service credits flowing to AP are acceptable and should not be flagged.

Expect a warranties article in the body; assess whether Kubient warrants performance for a meaningful period with a repair/re-perform or refund remedy, and note any broad disclaimer of implied warranties.
Missing-type rule — search the body and any exhibit references for insurance/coverage limits; if none, note the gap given Kubient handles AP data.
Presence rule — check fees/services text for minimum spend, take-or-pay or volume commitments binding AP; flag only if a commitment exists without a termination or true-up exit.
Look at the effects-of-termination language in the body for data return/deletion and transition assistance; if only deletion is addressed, treat the return-and-assistance element as the gap.
